_doc: Same-camera before/after capture (UPDATE_05 section 1, T-088). tools_src/capture.gd --set=<set> --label=<label> places the Player at pos (feet, metres; Map 0 frame +X east, +Z south, +Y up) with yaw (degrees, 0 = north / -Z, positive turns west) and pitch (degrees, negative looks down), lets the view settle and saves NN_<name>.png. kind: view (default) | zombie (one Ganger spawned at `subject`, frozen facing the camera) | squad (the three bots: the camera turns to their centroid) | viewmodel (plain view, the gun is the subject). Every pos is on the navmesh or a floor the player can stand on (test_capture_cams checks).
